sections.heading: Is-a.dev Free Domains
paragraphs: Skip the fluff and start here: is-a.dev gives you a real custom domain — username.is-a.dev — completely free, pointed at your GitHub Pages site.

The upshot: It is the fastest path from user.github.io/repo to a name that looks like an actual domain. You request the subdomain, add a CNAME record, and the platform handles the certificate. There is no invoice, ever.
No signup wall, no credit card — just a README and some patience.

sections.heading: Automate the boring parts
paragraphs: Start with the basics. Anything you do twice by hand should become a script. That's the entire discipline of free automation.

Concretely: A cron expression, a webhook, or a scheduled workflow costs nothing to run and buys back an hour every week. Start with one small automation — a nightly backup, a feed check, a deploy on push — and add more only when the first one proves itself.
